reason: The README describes a smart input plugin whose primary purpose is voice transcription into the DSH input box and configurable prompt enhancement, with optional online transcription and workspace context injection.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供语音转文字输入和可配置的提示词优化功能。
summaries.en: Adds speech-to-text input and configurable prompt enhancement features to DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: Captures microphone audio for speech-to-text input
Uses browser Web Speech API, local Whisper ONNX, or an online Whisper API for transcription
Transforms and enhances user-entered prompts using selectable strategies
Can inject workspace file context into prompt optimization
Provides configurable input controls, shortcuts, and continuous listening behavior
